en: A black‑and‑white vintage street scene in a small town or village. A wide unpaved road lined with leafless trees and wooden picket fences stretches into the distance. On the right are large wooden houses with steep roofs, window awnings, and balconies; one has a tower or spire-like structure behind it. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the street. In the background low hills or mountains are visible on the left side.
